title: Understanding N-grams
text: Think about how N-grams capture sequences. What happens when you have overlapping sequences?

title: Non-consecutive Segments
text: Consider how N-grams might mistakenly group non-consecutive letters. How could this affect the meaning of the data?

title: Meaningless Segments
text: What happens when N-grams capture segments that don't have biological significance? Think about segments shorter than three letters.

title: Wrap-around Segments
text: Does DNA wrap around like a circle? How might N-grams mistakenly capture sequences that don't exist in the data?
